title: Lightly Romantic Vietnamese Shrimp Bun Rieu
description: A delicate and flavorful Vietnamese dish featuring shrimp, rice noodles, and a rich broth, perfect for a romantic evening. This recipe combines the sweetness of rice syrup with the savory taste of shrimp and herbs.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs
ingredients.notes: such as mint, basil, and cilantro

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the sliced onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the peeled and deveined shrimp to the skillet and cook until they are pink and fully cooked.
In a small bowl, whisk together the rice syrup, fish sauce, and lime juice to make the sauce.
To assemble the dish, place some cooked noodles in a bowl, add a few shrimp, and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve immediately.
Dehydrate the fresh herbs in a low-temperature oven for a few hours to preserve them for future use.
